messages.content: Incident INC-4102 (SEV2) does NOT require a rollback. Affected in eu-central: search-indexer (6 desired, 4 healthy, 4.1% error rate, no owner note) and query-router (10 desired, 9 healthy, 1.8% error rate, owner note: elevated retries). Incident INC-4101 (SEV1) requires an immediate rollback. Remediation: step 1 drain checkout-api (60s timeout), step 2 rollback checkout-api (180s timeout). Primary approver: Maya Lin; secondary approver: Owen Brooks.
